- Recognition of transferable industrial skills, including machining, maintenance, electrical work, and logistics.

| Application | Practical benefit | Performance measure |

| Water-network leak detection | Less water loss | Verified leakage reduction |

- Public and environmental grants for cleanup, parks, training, and early infrastructure.
- Municipal capital budgets and suitable development-bank lending for durable public assets.
- Private investment for commercially viable buildings and businesses.
- Green bonds where borrowing capacity, repayment sources, and reporting systems are credible.
- Land-value capture where legally available and supported by market evidence.
- Verified energy savings to help finance suitable building upgrades.
